4613-4644-6857.easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-4644-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1445-2267-4871-8250.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-8250.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4068-4770-5301-6723.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3263-6871-8095--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-6871-8095--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-6871-8095--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

512-2085-6478.easyPrerequisites: Arbor Adherent and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-2085-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Arbor Adherent, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2085-6478.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Arbor Adherent's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-1496-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1496-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2757-4573-6441.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-6723-6970-7296-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

862-1591-2459-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1591-2459-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6822-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3062-3099-4762-6627.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Pir.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1849-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1849-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2921-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

465-997-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2757-3459-5078-5243.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Battered Golem, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

277-2692-2893-3875.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Tireless Provisioner and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4659-6705-7047.description:
Activate June by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-3963-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-3963-7009.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1446-3963-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3647-3821-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3647-3821-4823.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake
When Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3647-3821-4823.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1479-3478-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3478-6517.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Dragonback Assault, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-2079-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2079-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1644-3505-4423-4826-5226.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Plains.
Archelos is untapped.
1644-3505-4423-4826-5226.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Lithatog's second ability three times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains, giving Lithatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, returning all land cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Tatyova triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Second Sunrise on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

486-1102-1636-3197.notablePrerequisites: Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
486-1102-1636-3197.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's first ability by tapping it, causing Herd Baloth to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

678-1636-4026-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Elvish Piper does not have summoning sickness.
You have a creature card in hand.
678-1636-4026-4050.description:
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting any creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {G}.
The creature dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2188-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
2188-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature leaves the battlefield, triggering Flaming Fist Officer, putting a +1/+1 counter on Flaming Fist Officer.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

988-1211-1371-1409-1771.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus an additional {1}{U} for each opponent you have
988-1211-1371-1409-1771.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Umbris.
988-1211-1371-1409-1771.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Mana Severance.
Resolve each opponent's Mana Severance, searching for and exiling all land cards from their libraries.
Resolve your Mana Severance, choosing not to exile any land cards from your library.
Activate Umbris by paying {1}{U}, blinking Umbris.
Umbris triggers, revealing no lands from an opponent library, exiling their library.
Repeat from step 5 for each opponent.

1309-2103-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Salvager of Secrets.
1309-2103-4305.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Repeat.
